name: Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited
methodologies: Assigning Outlook or Rating Watch to Credit Ratings.md
Liquidity Analysis of Non-Financial Sector Entities - Sept 2024.md
step12_scaling_decision: Full artefact built, not scaled down: CMRL_5yr_Model.xlsx carries base and stress cases with the debt path derived from the funding gap. Noted that the gap is negative throughout - the issuer funds capex from accruals and is in net cash - so the forward view is about earnings recovery and ilmenite access, not leverage. FY2027 is anchored on Q1 FY2027 actuals rather than extrapolated from the FY2026 trough.
rating_outcome: CARE BBB; Stable / CARE A3+ (REVISED 13-Sep-2026 from CARE A-; Stable / CARE A2+). Rs 133.50 cr sanctioned limits (1.50 LT + 132.00 ST), imported verbatim from CareEdge's published action of 04-Sep-2026 under the five-condition amendment - CRA-published, not issuer-confirmed. STANDALONE. Anchor BBB with ZERO overlay notches: the original AA- anchor was an artefact of averaging a descriptive business-risk score against numerically banded financial ratios (failure mode 53); applying business risk as a ceiling (Inputs!C69 = BBB) reproduces CareEdge's published grade on both the long- and short-term scales. Two divergences remain open and disclosed in the report's Step 14 table: FY2025 PBILDT (30.88 vs 35.58) and the LC-backed creditor split behind the gearing difference (0.04x vs 0.31x, failure mode 47).
revision_note: Original 13-Sep-2026 delivery asserted three times that no CRA had rated this issuer. False: CareEdge's 04-Sep-2026 action was in the reference library and preflight.py probe [1] reported it PRESENT with its rated amounts and an explicit 'You may NOT write no prior rating action'. Failure modes 20/24/29. No mechanical check currently compares a delivered report against the pre-flight output that preceded it.
